module: Shifts the camera frustum center (scenetree.OnlyGui:setFrustumCameraCenterOffset) so that the 3D view is recentered when UI panels cover part of the screen (see BngFrustumMover.js). Accepts a raw offset in engine units and/or an offset as a fraction of half the screen, converted taking the screen ratio and the FoV into account.
notes: The engine offset is a slope in camera space: screen offset = offset / (aspect * tan(vFov/2)).
The FoV used is clamped to a minimum of 10 degrees, like the engine.
The screen offsets are recomputed in onUpdate as soon as the FoV changes.
Signs: a positive value of screenX/screenY shifts the view center to the right/up.

set.desc: Sets the offsets and applies them immediately. Any missing value is 0.

newRawX.desc: Raw horizontal offset (engine units), passed as is.

newRawY.desc: Raw vertical offset (engine units), passed as is.

newScreenX.desc: Horizontal offset as a fraction of half the screen width.

newScreenY.desc: Vertical offset as a fraction of half the screen height.

onUpdate.desc: Per-frame hook: if a screen offset is active and the FoV has changed since the last application, reapplies the offset.
